original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A broad thorn-root hedgecourt encloses timber training sheds behind a split claw-marked gate.
The controlled brambleback_hedgecourt stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
A translucent mireglass bell hangs between forked reedwood towers above a stilt platform.
The controlled mireglass_bellfen stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
Three pale cairn towers and a canvas bridge rise above a compact caravan yard.
The controlled windcairn_wayhouse stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
A spiral living tree opens into a dwelling beneath three great sapwood trumpets.
The controlled sapwhistle_greenward stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
A massive split bronze shield roofs a red-stone yard with jagged towers and a chained ram.
The controlled scarshield_breakyard stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
A curved signal mast, crescent sail roofs, and brass navigation rings rise from a narrow timber quay.
The controlled flaremast_pilotage stands open, supplied, lit, and marked for weekly neutral recruitment.
A shuttered rain-black rollhouse stands behind a cold charter brazier and lowered forked pennant.
The same rollhouse opens beneath a raised ember pennant, lit brazier, and ready veteran-company muster racks.
A dark iron chain ring lies slack among drowned posts, sealed drums, and an unlit fen lantern.
The same ring stands taut beneath raised chain pennants, lit drums, and occupied veteran muster posts.
A folded ivory drill prism rests between dark mirror fins and an empty sun-dial court.
The same prism opens into a bright daybreak array with raised mirror fins and supplied drill stations.
Five dormant boughs curl around sealed seed shields, folded kite racks, and a sleeping root altar.
The same five boughs flower around raised pennants, opened racks, and a luminous worldroot muster heart.
A cold black-brick foundry holds three dark gauges, a lowered bell hammer, and empty chapter racks.
The same foundry burns beneath three live gauges, a raised chapter pennant, and supplied veteran weapon racks.
A pale ribbed mooring stands under a furled fog sail, dark lantern, and sealed lastwatch bell.
The same mooring carries a raised pearl sail, lit bell-lanterns, and occupied veteran boarding racks.
A split basalt chimney, curved bronze cage ribs, ember vanes, and an empty hanging censer cradle mark the updraft roost.
A split basalt chimney, curved bronze cage ribs, ember vanes, and an empty hanging censer cradle mark the updraft roost.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Controlled basalt-and-bronze updraft roost with a physically draped ivory and gold stair runner; its original ember vanes, braziers and hanging censer remain.

original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: Two leaning crescent shell arches enclose a dark mirror basin, dangling reed chains, and a low root landing pier.
Two leaning crescent shell arches enclose a dark mirror basin, dangling reed chains, and a low root landing pier.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Tended iridescent shell basin with a teal-bordered ivory cloth laid across the existing boarding dock; original shells, water, ropes and hanging charms remain.

original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: An ivory floating shelf carries an offset oval lens arch, two prism sails, glass chimes, and three narrow crystal keels.
An ivory floating shelf carries an offset oval lens arch, two prism sails, glass chimes, and three narrow crystal keels.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Controlled prismatic refraction shelf with a blue-and-gold runner fitted to its existing stone stair and balcony; translucent sails and hanging crystals remain.

original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A living-root amphitheater rises into two unequal antler gates around a hollow dais and three seed-lantern pods.
A living-root amphitheater rises into two unequal antler gates around a hollow dais and three seed-lantern pods.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Tended antler-root court with an emerald woven mat laid onto its original wooden dais; exposed wood rim, stairs, roots and amber lanterns remain.

original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: Three concentric pressure rings frame a dark drill rail beneath oversized blank gauges, a red relief valve, and six anchor feet.
Three concentric pressure rings frame a dark drill rail beneath oversized blank gauges, a red relief valve, and six anchor feet.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Working brass pressure burrow with three warm amber backlit gauges, keeping the original dark needles, portal, drill rails, anchor feet and relief valve.

original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A tilted whalebone arch shelters one drowned bell, two tideglass pools, pale sounding rods, and a narrow keel stair.
A tilted whalebone arch shelters one drowned bell, two tideglass pools, pale sounding rods, and a narrow keel stair.

integrated_state_edit.accessible_description: Tended bone-and-tide sanctuary with a fitted navy and gold stair runner on the original steps, retaining both pools, bell, arch and sounding rods.
